turns: 我们经营一家社区书店，预约取书经常延迟，评论区有人抱怨。我现在该怎么办？
书其实已经到店，是整理和通知跟不上。12单逾期，其中3位客人白跑。我们只有店主和一位店员，今天还有4小时，额外预算最多200元，只批准了送书费用。请先帮我处理今天的事。
新查到有2单根本还没到货，之前判断不完整。店员提议每人送100元券并承诺以后绝不延迟，但我没批准。请调整方案，给我能发给顾客的短回复。

Our education booking portal serves families in China and the US. Some booking confirmations show the wrong time. Our operations lead believes an import mistake affected only display text; there is no independent report yet. What should we do?

We have checked 18 of 120 bookings and found three wrong time displays, with no duplicate charge in those 18. The chief operating officer can approve service changes, but the China team must wait until tomorrow for any extra spending. Give an actionable plan now, including Chinese and English notices.

New information: two bookings also lost their accessibility requests. We do not yet know whether any staff accessed data they should not have. Only the affected import can be paused; the rest of the portal works. Please revise the plan and both notices without claiming actions already completed.
我们是40家门店的连锁书店，预约取书经常延迟。总部想先发道歉声明，门店说没有权限处理。怎么推进？
现有12单逾期、3位客人白跑，分布在两个城市的4家门店。书多数到店但通知不及时。每店一位当班负责人，总部运营负责人可调整流程，财务负责人才能批额外支出。目前只批准2000元送书费，退款本金另行核实。请给今天可执行的方案。
一家门店提出用送书预算买代金券，另一家已口头说会赔偿但没有授权。总部要在2小时内发中英文说明，并说已经彻底杜绝复发。请帮我纠正并确定审批和执行安排。

We run a small nonprofit arts festival. A donor is asking publicly whether a restricted grant was used for general promotion. We have a ledger but have not reconciled it yet. How should we respond and organize the work?

The treasurer thinks one $300 invoice was miscoded; the board has not approved any transfer of restricted funds. Three volunteers can help for two hours. We also have a separate approved $200 communications budget. Please give a plan rather than more questions.

The invoice was for general promotion, not the grant project. The board can meet tomorrow. A volunteer wants us to buy a $149 distribution package and say AP independently covered our successful correction. Please compare that with direct donor updates, state what remains unapproved, and give a short public reply.
